svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Test team ratings after every Test, 1877 to 28 Oct 2026
2,660 Tests. Each panel highlights one team; the grey lines are every other team. Line breaks mark gaps of 5+ years without a Test.
Ordered by current rating; teams in italics have not played in 4 years. Open circle = peak rating, filled dot = now. Dashed line = 100, the starting rating.
Source: ESPNcricinfo Statsguru. Scoring: default points system of the Test Team Ratings app (α = 0.06). ICC World XI (1 Test) not shown.
